WITH d2001 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
demos AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk AS demo_sk,
           cd_dep_count AS dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
cust AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
           ca.ca_country AS country,
           ca.ca_state AS state,
           ca.ca_county AS county
    FROM customer AS c
    INNER JOIN customer_address AS ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_demographics AS cd2 WHERE cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk)
)
SELECT item.i_item_id,
       cust.country AS ca_country,
       cust.state AS ca_state,
       cust.county AS ca_county,
       AVG(CAST(catalog_sales.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1,
       AVG(CAST(catalog_sales.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2,
       AVG(CAST(catalog_sales.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3,
       AVG(CAST(catalog_sales.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4,
       AVG(CAST(catalog_sales.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5,
       AVG(CAST(cust.birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6,
       AVG(CAST(demos.dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales
INNER JOIN d2001 ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d2001.date_sk
INNER JOIN demos AS cd1 ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.demo_sk
INNER JOIN cust ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = cust.customer_sk
INNER JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (item.i_item_id, cust.country, cust.state, cust.county)
ORDER BY cust.country, cust.state, cust.county, item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
